sources.description: Source files relative to the workspace, listed in compilation order. Place design dependencies first and the testbench last.

top.description: Basic entity name of the top-level testbench.

libraryPaths.description: Search directories for existing compiled libraries, specified as workspace-relative or absolute paths.

dumpArrays.description: Write nested arrays with up to this many elements to the waveform. Set to 0 to disable. Higher values increase memory use and waveform file size.
